newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel seek to get back above 128.30.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel seek to get back above 128.30.

text.p: June notionnel futures on the MATIF will try to close a gap up to 128.30 on Wednesday as the market recovers in line with Bunds, technical analysts said.
The June contract left a gap from a low at 128.30 on March 17 and have since only climbed as high as 128.16.
"We should see a recovery in the market," said Simon Mattholie, proprietary trader at Deutsche Bank in London.
"France has fallen almost in line with Germany. One would have thought with the EMU problems it would have sold off more, but it's actually fallen one for one."
The June contract at 0822 GMT was at 127.98, up 0.06.

At the short end, June Pibor futures were at 96.52, up two basis points from the prior close. They had managed to get back above the 96.50-51 threshold, an area of old lows which had been support and then proved to be resistance on Tuesday.
